comments.author: luizebas
comments.body:
I like doing this Battle Report by killing 2 "Mediterranean Trade Fleet" that instantly respawn when the other is killed.

The 1st fleet is located straight east of Malaga. The second one is straight south from the 1st fleet.

I have read somewhere that these fleets only give EXP until Maritime Level 42. But I'm currently on Level 44 and I'm earning 330 Battle Exp per fleet (during 100% Bonus).
